title: Treat Your Feet Doraville
specs: Located near I-285 in Doraville, GA
Offers prenatal massages safe for pregnant women over 20 weeks
Sports massages to improve muscle recovery and flexibility
Must be over 20 weeks pregnant for prenatal massage
Children under 6 years old not allowed; ages 6-16 must be accompanied by adult and receive service
Guests receiving body or foot reflexology massage should not exceed 250 pounds
Disclose medical conditions and pregnancy status before service
Credit card required to hold reservations for parties of 4 or more; full charge if less than 24-hour cancellation or no-show

options.detail: Massage to relieve muscle tension and improve flexibility for athletes and active individuals

options.name: Prenatal Massage
options.detail: Massage tailored for pregnant women over 20 weeks

gap: No explicit weight limit for prenatal or sports massages
blurb: Guests receive various massage treatments including foot reflexology, prenatal massage, sports massage, and full-body massages designed to relieve tension, improve circulation, and promote relaxation. Prenatal massages are tailored for pregnant women over 20 weeks. Sports massages help with muscle recovery and injury prevention.
